context: Momentum was positive on all three indices but GRADUAL, never sharp -- SENSEX did not cross its round number. A slow move breeds no greed, so the buyers who came did not hold overnight and are NOT seated.
plan: BOTH GAP BRANCHES REVERSE FROM YESTERDAY AND THE FLAT BRANCH DOES NOT: 21 Sep was gap up -> SELL, flat or gap down -> BUY. Tonight gap up -> BUY, gap down -> SELL, flat still -> BUY. Carrying yesterday's gaps forward inverts both.

FLAT TO GAP UP -> BUY: identify buying-side setups and go WITH the market. The rise was gradual so no greed formed, buyers came but 'did not go holding the trade', and an unseated buyer crowd is nobody to squeeze.

GAP DOWN -> SELL: identify selling-side setups. NOT because sellers are seated -- because a fall is only covered if an OPERATOR commits money, retail cannot produce that bounce, and 'we can get TRAPPED there' planning for one.
SAME SHAPE ON ALL THREE INDICES: NIFTY, BANKNIFTY and SENSEX carry identical branches with NO per-index qualification tonight -- unlike 21 Sep, where NIFTY alone was limited to a SMALL gap down.
